items.summary: 卫星智能体需利用有限星载观测预测碰撞风险，但传统规划器依赖预定义地图和固定假设。本文提出Orbit-Planner，一种两阶段潜在世界模型，学习动作条件航天器动力学，在潜在空间进行未来状态展开，并引入物理探测器从想象轨迹解码物理状态变化。实验显示其可进行长时程潜在展开，在Isaac Sim闭环避障成功率达91.7%。

However, conventional planners often rely on predefined maps and fixed environmental assumptions, limiting their adaptability in dynamic on-orbit scenarios. In this paper, we propose Orbit-Planner, a two-stage latent world model for on-orbit obstacle avoidance. items.abstract: A language model's output does not by itself provide verifiable evidence about the internal computation that produced it. We test a bounded form of this idea in two controlled architectures: a modular feed-forward neural network and a transformer-based model. Both architectures are trained on the same arithmetic task with a mandatory pathway through two discrete intermediate s…

items.originalTitle: What Do Compliance Detectors Read? An Audit of Activation Probes and Guard Models
items.summary: 展示当前合规检测器存在规则盲区：删除、替换或置换规则不影响检测准确性。构建跨两条规则和两个场景的基准，证明逐步推理而非快速检测器能解决。引入免训练的内部合规评分（ICS），但预注册标准未达标，词袋模型匹配其泛化性能。ICS成本低，可审计多个部署模型，但自适应白盒攻击消除其收益。
items.abstract: Regulatory compliance monitoring in deployed language models is increasingly implemented as a legal and audit control, checking model outputs against written rules spanning data protection, healthcare, financial regulation, and platform policy. Such monitoring is meaningful only if a detector's verdict depends on the stated rule rather than on surface features of the scenario. We show this condition fails across the current class of compliance detectors, a failure we call rule blindness. Deleting, permuting, or su…
keyFacts: 当前合规检测器的判定是否依赖规则本身而非表面特征？
通过对检测器进行反事实实验（删除、置换、替换规则）测其准确性变化，构建跨越规则和场景的基准，并引入免训练的内部合规评分（ICS），与预注册标准和词袋模型比较。

items.originalTitle: CytoFormer: A Molecularly Supervised Cell Foundation Model for Histopathology Cell Classification
items.summary: CytoFormer利用成像空间转录组与H&E染色配对数据，构建细胞基础模型。基于81个跨16器官的Xenium切片，获得1540万细胞，23种细胞类型，以多任务逐器官分类头训练。在空间留出组织上准确率0.85、宏F1为0.78，且表示可迁移至专家标注基准，并在主动学习设置中展现了更高的标签效率。
items.abstract: Identifying cell types directly from routine haematoxylin and eosin (H&E) histology would enable single-cell analysis at scale, but training such models has relied on manual pathologist annotations, which are slow, expensive and unreliable for many cell types. We instead supervise morphology with molecules. Imaging-based spatial transcriptomics profiles individual cells in situ on a section that can afterwards be stained with H&E, so that molecular identity and morphology are observed for the same physical cell. keyFacts: 如何无需人工标注，利用分子信息监督形态学训练可泛化的组织病理学细胞分类模型？
使用配对H&E与空间转录组数据，通过聚类和人工审查获得细胞类型标签，训练多任务逐器官分类头的细胞基础模型CytoFormer。
空间留出组织准确率0.85、宏F1 0.78；线性头在四个专家标注基准上优于六个病理基础模型；主动学习效率更高，正常上皮检测F1为0.82，领先最强基线0.13。
